name: Anastasis Giakoumatos
tagline: Android apps used by millions, shipped faster with AI
intro: I'm a Mobile Engineer specializing in Android, based in Athens. For 7 years I've built apps people trust with their money: banking, payments and iGaming apps used by millions. Today AI is part of how I ship: coding agents help me move faster, automation takes repetitive work off the team, and AI features go in where they make an app genuinely better. What hasn't changed is the bar. Clean architecture, tests and code reviews keep speed from ever costing stability.
